description: This file defines the UserService class in the OrangeHRM system, providing user management functionalities such as saving users, retrieving user info, deleting users, role management, password verification, and user search within the admin plugin.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class providing user management functions such as create, retrieve, delete, role management, password validation, and search within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: geUserDao
methods.description: Returns the UserDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getPasswordHasher
methods.description: Returns the PasswordHash instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Saves a User object to the system, hashing the password if provided.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User by user ID.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft delete of users by their IDs.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves a UserRole by role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching search filters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on filter parameters.

methods.name: isCurrentPassword
methods.description: Checks if the provided password matches the current password of the user.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees with a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on provided credentials.

methods.name: checkPasswordHash
methods.description: Verifies a password against a hash.

methods.name: checkForOldHash
methods.description: Checks if a password matches an old hash format (MD5).

methods.name: getUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of users that cannot be deleted, such as the current user and default admin in demo mode.
